The roof is split into two outward-sloping wedge shapes meeting at the central ridge, ensuring correct drainage slope. The stone texture is represented by the facadeHex, and the terracotta roof tiles are represented by the roofHex. The small wooden window and ground-level openings are precisely positioned as separate box elements slightly offset from the main walls to prevent Z-fighting. The back and side walls are fully reconstructed to form a complete, closed 3D volume.
